Hi James — great to meet you.

High-level answer up front: yes, we can structure both 12m and 24m prepay options with a ramp-friendly credit mechanism and milestone-based top-ups. I'll summarize a starter proposal below and attach a one-pager and sample term summary.

Starter proposal (illustrative):
- 12-month prepay: up-front payment for 9 months of expected usage (effective ~11% discount vs month-to-month).
- 24-month prepay: up-front payment for 18 months of expected usage (effective ~20% discount), with option to draw down remaining credits in year 3 at a reduced rate.
- Ramp buffer: 20% early-period headroom credits reserved for the first 90 days to cover lower-than-expected adoption (non-refundable draw to credit account).
- Milestone credits: 2 one-time credits (each equivalent to 5% of first-year prepay value) triggered on: (a) achieving 95% API availability for a rolling 30d window, (b) average token latency <150ms for 30d during production traffic.
- Usage smoothing: ability to apply unused credits to future months within the commitment window; partial refund only at special exec review (typical startup concession: up to 10% of unused prepay at 12m term).

I'm looping in Karthik (deal lead) and Ben (pricing lead) to finalize numbers. I'll drop a short term PDF now.

Sofia

James — quick follow up on structure and a couple of clarifying Qs so we're modeling this correctly:

1) Forecast cadence: can you confirm the month-by-month token/embedding forecast in the attached? If you can provide % growth assumptions we'll bake that into the ramp buffer sizing.
2) Legal: is BlueGrove looking for standard Redwood terms or do you need an exec summary for finance/procurement with updated IP/data clauses?

We typically recommend (A) for admin simplicity, but earmarked credits (B) are doable for larger orgs.
